raw_text: member_002 (独立复核) ready. Issue: ValueError in _pytest/compat.py num_mock_patch_args — `p.new in sentinels` on numpy array returns array and raises ValueError. Expected fix: identity-based membership check, e.g. `any(p.new is sentinel for sentinel in sentinels)`, keeping the "explicit new arg means no extra funcarg" behavior. My independent review plan: integrate your fixed patch (via handoff_patch), run tests on that exact version, focused on tests/test_compat.py / unittest-mock collection plus a numpy-array-patch reproduction, then accept or request changes. Please publish your final fixed candidate with fix_patch(task_ids=[]) and send me handoff_patch when ready. Do not include unrelated changes; keep it minimal.

Please adopt, run public tests and review this final candidate (patch-1, exact source v5, files_sha256 aea23f5b...).

Change: src/_pytest/compat.py num_mock_patch_args now uses identity matching `any(p.new is sentinel for sentinel in sentinels)` instead of `p.new in sentinels`, so @patch(new=np.array(...)) no longer raises "ValueError: truth value of an array ... is ambiguous" during collection, while mock.DEFAULT patchings (without attribute_name) still count as consumed funcargs.
Also added testing/test_compat.py regression tests: test_num_mock_patch_args_with_array_new (an object whose __eq__ raises, mimicking numpy) and test_num_mock_patch_args_keeps_default_counting (importorskip("mock")).

My public evidence on this exact version: run_tests pytest targeting testing/test_compat.py -k num_mock_patch_args => 1 passed, 1 skipped, validation_status passed. A broader selection (testing/test_compat.py + testing/test_unittest.py) shows 3 failures that look like pre-existing environment/output-format assertions unrelated to this change (e.g. expects "* 1 passed in*" but got "1 passed, 1 warnings in 0.00 seconds"; test_setup_inheritance_skipping subtest formatting). Please confirm independently whether those fail on the unpatched baseline too; suggested focus: testing/test_compat.py plus a small repro using @patch(new=np.array([-5.5,3.0])).

REVIEW ACCEPTED: patch-1 (source v5, files_sha256 aea23f5b...). I adopted it (integrate_patch, 0 conflicts) and ran public tests on that exact version: report test-report-7ca1a3fbd0b160e2ea3237b5, sequence 37, v2, 10 collected / 9 passed / 1 skipped / 0 errors-failed. Fix confirmed correct: identity matching replaces `p.new in sentinels`, so @patch(new=np.array(...)) no longer raises the ambiguous-truth ValueError during collection while mock.DEFAULT patchings without attribute_name still count.

Note: test_num_mock_patch_args_keeps_default_counting was SKIPPED (no `mock` module available), so it is not evidence; only test_num_mock_patch_args_with_array_new actually exercised the fix. Consider making that test use unittest.mock or pytest.importorskip on unittest.mock so it isn't silently skipped.
